hook: A 3D-printed rover that picks up litter.

beats.say: Meet MOSS, an open-source, mostly 3D-printed rover built by metrox to collect litter.
It rolls on tracks, grabs trash with a robotic arm, and drops it into a rear bin. The idea started while picking up trash in Thailand.
It went from concept to working prototype in just two months, with help from Codex, and the build is being shared openly so others can make one.
